Package org.cibseven.connect.ai.agent.agentic

Class AgenticTurnJobRetryCmd

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.cmd.JobRetryCmd
org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.cmd.DefaultJobRetryCmd
org.cibseven.connect.ai.agent.agentic.AgenticTurnJobRetryCmd
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command<Object>
public class AgenticTurnJobRetryCmd extends DefaultJobRetryCmd
The engine's retry of a failed job, for a turn job (CIB7-2149): the next attempt waits for the scope's retry cycle instead of following at once.

Only two things differ from the engine's own command. The activity is the scope, which is the turn job's execution; the engine looks one up only for timer and async-continuation jobs. And the cycle is the one AgenticTurnRetry parsed onto that scope. Counting, the first failure setting the retries to the cycle's, the due date and the incident at the end stay the engine's.
